# Sevra

> AI-powered crisis management platform that helps organizations detect, decide, and respond to reputation crises in real time.

Sevra brings together social monitoring, crisis-level scoring (L0–L4), AI-drafted statements, approvals, and distribution in one workspace — built for crisis teams across transportation, healthcare, financial services, utilities and telecoms, retail and hospitality, education and the public sector.

The workspace adapts to the customer's industry: incident fields, the incident taxonomy, AI classification, and drafted communications all use the vocabulary of that sector.
